text:
jo (ml): FYI we started seeing sporadic OOMs on lucent13b during long chat sessions. looks tied to int4 build with aggressive batching and prefetch.
ravi (infra): can you share a minimal repro config? is this microbatching, large batch, or many tokens per session?
jo (ml): repro config below. errors happen in steady-state after ~8-12k cumulative tokens per session.
```
model: lucent13b
quant: int4
batch_size: 8
max_new_tokens: 1024
prefetch: aggressive
```
lucy (runtime): that combination is a known pressure point: int4 reduces per-alloc size but increases allocation churn for KV caches and prefetch pages. large microbatch (8) + deep generation = freelist fragmentation.
claire (prodex): can we try lowering defaults for hosted? maybe reduce max_new_tokens and batch defaults before wider rollout. need to balance UX vs stability.
ravi (infra): quick canary plan: push a conservative config to two nodes: batch_size=4, max_new_tokens=512, prefetch=lazy, kv_eviction_threshold=0.7. tagging canary/lucent13b/2026-03-23b.
deploy-bot: rolling out canary -> nodes: gpu-211,gpu-218 (tag: canary/lucent13b/2026-03-23b).
jo (ml): running our long-context eval set (200 sessions, avg 9k history). baseline failure rate ~1.2% (OOMs + alloc fails) on default. will post early numbers in 30m.
lucy (runtime): also enable slot_compactor (low qos) and `kv_prefetch_lazy=true` on the canary. compactor reclaims fragmented slots in background and reduces RSS creep.
ravi (infra): applied runtime flags on canary.
jo (ml): 30m snapshot: canary failure rate 0.1%, p95 latency +40ms, RSS peaks slightly lower (~-400MB). quality (EM) change vs int8-fallback: int4-only -0.7% EM, with auto-fallback above 20k session tokens gap is -0.15%.
claire (prodex): good trade. propose default hosted settings: max_new_tokens=512, default_batch=4, prefetch=lazy, kv_eviction_threshold=0.75, and an auto-fallback policy to int8 at session_token_count>20k. note in console: "lucent13b int4: tuned defaults for long sessions; use Dedicated for high-token jobs".
lucy (runtime): agree. also recommend a soft backoff: if eviction fires >3x in 5m for a session, throttle prefetch for that session. prevents oscillation between eviction and refetch.
ravi (infra): scheduling 24h canary with those defaults and adding affinity probe to detect kernel collocation. will also add a metric `freelist_fragmentation_pct` to alert early.
jo (ml): action items for ML: run full Evals export (convo QA + SQuAD subset) after 24h to confirm EM delta <1%. if >1% revert fallback threshold or ship int8 default.
claire (prodex): I'll draft a release blurb and update docs with the new defaults and recommended dedicated node guidance.
deploy-bot: canary update: 0 OOMs in last 120m, compactor jobs running (qos=low).
lucy (runtime): one caveat: if customers pin max_new_tokens >512 we'll route them to Dedicated or apply per-customer soft quotas. add note in routing policy.
jo (ml): thanks all. TL;DR: root cause isolated to prefetch+int4+high batch & long sessions; mitigations effective in canary (lower defaults + lazy prefetch + compactor + int8-fallback). will post 24h eval CSV and final recommendation. :thumbsup:
